munich.note: No factory calibration. Assumed pinhole, principal point at the image centre, zero pitch/roll, camera height 1.5 m. Horizontal FOV 70 deg (fx=fy=914) from the prior WildDet3D intrinsics estimate on this clip (sam-bev-22nov used fx=800 ~77 deg; an earlier cams.json used fx=1065 ~62 deg). No motion.csv; constant-speed ego, zero yaw. | iter2: road vanishing row measured at ~552 px (not cy=360; iter1 road band 0.48-0.96 started ~200 px above the horizon). horizon_v=552 -> pitch -11.8 deg equivalent; road band 0.78-0.95. | iter3: road_y1 0.985 (nearest ground ~8.5 m); lane metrics at z=12/20.

a2d2a.note: Not raw A2D2. 594x334 crop of a dashboard screen recording of the camera_front_wide_120fov panel (same crop as sam-bev-22nov / drive-videos-22nov). The 120 deg figure is the source camera, not this crop; using 66 deg (fx=fy=457.3, cx=297, cy=167) from the prior WildDet3D estimate (a 120 deg pinhole would be fx=171.5 and was previously reported as too wide). Camera height 1.5 m, principal at centre, zero pitch/roll. The bonnet/HUD occupies roughly the bottom 28% of the frame and is excluded from the road band. No motion.csv; constant-speed ego, zero yaw. | iter2: keep 66 deg (WD3D K estimate); run the --hfov-deg 66/90/120 check (see SPEC 2d). Lane width cannot pin fx on flat ground. | burned-in HUD reads "projection=physical_ai_calibration:camera_front_wide_120fov" (source camera FOV; the crop width is unknown).

_iter3_oxts: Add 'oxts_speed_mps' (scalar or per-frame list) to a clip to override ego speed (fallback: oxts > flow if consistent > scene > prior). No KITTI oxts on the box: the 6 KITTI clips' source drives are not recorded.
_iter4_capture_hz: Real-time rate of file frames. KITTI clips are 10 Hz captures stored at 4 fps (iter1-3 used 4 -> speeds/accels/trails off by 2.5x). munich.mp4 repeats every frame (15 Hz content in a 30 fps file); repeats are detected and skipped for ego motion.
